message.content:
An editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover with a light beige background and a red vertical bar on the left. The masthead "TEMPO" in large black serif letters spans the top. A caricature of a man occupies the center, shown from the waist up. He has black hair, a tan complexion, and is wide-mouthed in a laugh or shout. He wears a black suit, a white shirt, and a yellow tie. In each hand, he holds a gold-colored trophy shaped like a human figure on a black tiered base. Above his head to the right, a single black dress shoe with laces flies through the air, overlapping the letter "O" in the masthead. 

Bold gold text to the right of the man reads "SATU PERKARA SERIBU DRAMA". Smaller black text below it says "BEBERAPA JAM SEBELUM DISERGAP KPK, SETYA NOVANTO MENGHILANG. MENDAPAT BOCORAN DARI ORANG DALAM?". At the top, black text reads "INVESTIGASI: SATWA LANGKA DI RUMAH PEJABAT NEGARA / PERSEKUSI DI CIKUPA". A barcode and publication details including "20-26 NOVEMBER 2017" and "RP 45.000" are in the bottom left corner.
